title: 牙齿的故事
subtitle: 乳牙、蛀牙和换牙
character: wearing a mint green t-shirt, orange shorts and white socks, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration made of cut felt fabric pieces with visible stitching and soft fuzzy texture, flat simple rounded shapes, warm pastel colors on a cream felt background

pages.zh:
早上起床，我对着镜子笑了一下。
镜子里的我，
露出一排白白的小牙齿。
我数了数上面的，
又数了数下面的。
pages.scene: The little boy stands in front of a bathroom mirror smiling widely at his reflection, showing a row of small white teeth, morning light in a cosy bathroom.

pages.zh:
我很小的时候，
嘴里一颗牙也没有。
那时候只能喝奶，
什么都咬不动。
妈妈说，小婴儿都是这样的。
pages.scene: A small baby lying on a soft blanket, laughing with its mouth open and no teeth at all, a milk bottle beside the blanket.

pages.zh:
一岁左右，
牙齿一颗一颗冒了出来。
这些小时候长的牙，
有一个名字，
叫「乳牙」。
pages.scene: A simple clear picture of a row of small white baby teeth in a pink gum, drawn large in the middle of the picture, with a few teeth just poking through.

pages.zh:
乳牙一共有二十颗，
上面十颗，下面十颗。
它们排得整整齐齐，
像两排小房子。
pages.scene: A simple chart picture: ten small white teeth in an upper arch and ten in a lower arch, evenly spaced on a plain background.

pages.zh:
前面的牙又扁又薄，
边儿像小铲子，
专门用来把食物切断。
咬苹果的时候，
就是它们在工作。
pages.scene: Close view of two flat front teeth biting into a red apple, leaving a clean bite mark in the apple, simple and clear.

pages.zh:
后面的牙又宽又厚，
上面有小小的凸起，
像一块块小石磨，
把食物磨得碎碎的，
这样才好吞下去。
pages.scene: Close view of a wide back tooth with bumpy ridges on top, grinding a piece of food into small crumbs, simple and clear.

pages.zh:
中午我啃了一个大苹果。
咔嚓一声，
前面的牙切下一块，
后面的牙嚼呀嚼，
把它磨得碎碎的。
pages.scene: The little boy takes a big bite out of a red apple with both hands holding it, his eyes happy, a bite mark left in the apple.

pages.zh:
吃完东西，
牙齿上会留下一点点看不见的碎渣，
特别是甜甜的糖。
用眼睛看不出来，
可它们真的在那里。
pages.scene: Close view of a single white tooth with a few tiny crumbs and a small sticky sugar smear on its surface, drawn simply on a plain background.

pages.zh:
我们的嘴里，
还住着好多好多细菌。
它们非常非常小，
最喜欢吃的，
就是留在牙上的糖。
pages.scene: A few friendly-looking round cartoon germs with tiny arms sitting on a big white tooth, small and simple, not scary.

pages.zh:
细菌吃了糖，
会产生一种酸。
酸天天泡着牙齿，
就会在牙上，
慢慢咬出一个小洞。
pages.scene: A big white tooth with a small dark hole starting on its surface and a few tiny drops drawn around the hole, simple and clear.

pages.zh:
有了小洞，牙就会疼。
我去看了牙医。
牙医是一位戴眼镜、
穿白大褂的大人，
他让我张开嘴，用小镜子照了照。
pages.scene: At a friendly dentist's office the little boy sits in the chair with his mouth open, and a grown adult male dentist with glasses in a white coat leans over him holding a small round mirror, a parent sitting beside the chair.

pages.zh:
牙医说：
「补好了，不疼了。
以后每天早晚都要刷牙哦。」
我用力点了点头。
pages.scene: The little boy sits up in the dentist's chair smiling and nodding, the grown adult male dentist with glasses in a white coat standing beside him giving a thumbs up.

pages.zh:
早上一次，晚上一次。
我挤上一点点牙膏，
像一粒豌豆那么多，
然后开始刷。
pages.scene: The little boy stands at the bathroom sink squeezing a small pea-sized dot of toothpaste onto his toothbrush, looking focused.

pages.zh:
刷牙要刷够时间。
妈妈让我唱两遍生日歌，
唱完才算刷好。
沙漏里的沙子漏完，
差不多也是这么久。
pages.scene: A small hourglass standing on the edge of a bathroom sink with sand running through it, a toothbrush lying beside it, simple and clear.

pages.zh:
上面的牙要往下刷，
下面的牙要往上刷，
外面刷完刷里面，
最后别忘了后面的大牙，
它们最容易被漏掉。
pages.scene: The little boy brushes his back teeth with his mouth open in front of the mirror, holding the toothbrush at an angle, white foam around his lips.

pages.zh:
牙缝里也会藏东西。
牙刷进不去的地方，
要用牙线。
细细的线滑进牙缝，
把碎渣带出来。
pages.scene: Close view of a thin piece of dental floss slipping between two white teeth and pulling out a tiny crumb, simple and clear.

pages.zh:
过了一阵子，
我的一颗下门牙开始松了。
我用舌头一顶，
它就晃呀晃。
妈妈说：别怕，这是要换牙了。
pages.scene: The little boy stands in front of the mirror with his mouth open, pointing at one wobbly lower front tooth with his finger, looking surprised and excited.

pages.zh:
掉了的地方，
会长出新的牙，
叫做恒牙。
恒牙不会再换了，
要陪我一辈子。
所以我要好好照顾它们。
pages.scene: The little boy smiles widely at the mirror showing a gap where one lower front tooth is missing and a new tooth just starting to come up, holding his toothbrush like a little flag.
